description: This file defines an Angular component 'ImeAdditionalPropertiesComponent' used to display detailed properties related to input method editors (IMEs), such as WM State, SF Layer, Focus, Visibility, and other IME-specific metadata. The component leverages Angular decorators, templates, and styles to create an interactive UI panel.

classes.name: ImeAdditionalPropertiesComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and interacting with IME related properties within a user interface

methods.name: isHighlighted
methods.description: Checks if a specific item is highlighted based on the highlighted items list.

methods.name: formatProto
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed string representation of an object if available.

methods.name: wmProtoOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the WM proto object if available.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderOrNull
methods.description: Constructs and returns the IME Insets Source Provider object or null.

methods.name: wmControlTargetFrameOrNull
methods.description: Gets the control target window frame from WM proto.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderPositionOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the IAM source provider.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderIsLeashReadyOrNull
methods.description: Returns whether the leash is ready for dispatching.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderControllableOrNull
methods.description: Checks if the source provider is controllable.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceFrameOrNull
methods.description: Gets the source frame of the source provider.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceVisibleOrNull
methods.description: Returns the visibility status of the source.

methods.name: wmInsetsSourceProviderSourceVisibleFrameOrNull
methods.description: Gets the visible frame of the source provider.

methods.name: wmImeControlTargetOrNull
methods.description: Fetches the IME control target object.

methods.name: wmImeControlTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the IME control target window container.

methods.name: wmImeInputTargetOrNull
methods.description: Returns the IME input target object.

methods.name: wmImeInputTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Fetches the title of the IME input target window container.

methods.name: wmImeLayeringTargetOrNull
methods.description: Gets the IME layering target object.

methods.name: wmImeLayeringTargetTitleOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the IME layering target window container.

methods.name: sfImeContainerScreenBoundsOrNull
methods.description: Returns the screen bounds of the IME container.

methods.name: sfImeContainerRectOrNull
methods.description: Returns the rectangle bounds of the IME container.

methods.name: isAllPropertiesNull
methods.description: Checks if all relevant IME properties are null or undefined.

methods.name: onClickShowInPropertiesPanel
methods.description: Dispatches an event to highlight or select an item based on user interaction.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Updates the highlighted items by dispatching a 'HighlightedChange' event.

methods.name: updateAdditionalPropertySelected
methods.description: Dispatches an event to select an additional property.
